name: April Brunski
prior_offices: Lincoln County clerk (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026; listed on the official clerk page)
background: April Brunski is the Lincoln County clerk and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official clerk page lists her in that office. SVI-NEWS reported that her race was decided in the Republican primary and that she was unopposed in the general election.
